## What changes?

Describe the problem and what a person will experience after this change. Link a related issue if there is one.

## How did you check it?

Describe the checks you ran and their results, including any limits or work still needed.

Use fictional examples only. Do not include Facebook archives, screenshots of real members, credentials or private configuration in the change or its discussion. Follow [the security policy](https://github.com/Dynobit/clean-bookface/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for security or privacy flaws.
